name: Improvement proposal

title: "proposal: "

## Problem

What engineering decision does the current skill miss or make harder?

## Evidence

Link a reproducible example, transcript, diff, test output, or benchmark artifact. Describe the baseline behavior as well as the proposed behavior.

## Proposed change

What is the smallest instruction, example, check, or packaging change that addresses the problem?

## Trade-offs

What extra context, complexity, false-positive risk, or maintenance cost would this add?
